issue.title: Restore stale ACE tests and PNG visual goldens
issue.description: A full just test run during the Artifacts action-module split reported 24,990 passed, 313 failed, 7 skipped, and 1 collection error. Representative independent failures: test_admin_center_selection_resume.py imports removed helper _patch_store_loader; test_copy_as_palette_entrypoints.py assigns plans/chats as top-level Artifacts subtabs and raises KeyError now that they are nested under Files; and many PNG snapshots drift, including the isolated Commits timeline golden with 0.335343% materially changed pixels. Update stale test assumptions/imports, investigate or accept intentional visual changes, and restore a clean just test run.
